R462.note: Replaces Math.random() with SecureRandom-based 16-byte hex token, appropriate API; token is opaque/compared with equals so the format change is harmless.

R463.note: os.system replaced with subprocess.run using an argument list and stdout/stderr redirected to the same log file, matching original semantics; no observable behavior change.

R464.note: Routes through self.get_object(), which applies get_queryset() scoping and check_object_permissions(); matches the stated contract for owners, staff, and indistinguishable 404s.

R465.note: Fix will not compile: order.getUserId() does not exist on Order (only getCustomerUsername()/getShippingAddress()/getStatus()), and AccessDeniedException is used without being imported.

R466.note: Parameterized query with sqlite3 '?' placeholder; preserves exact-match search semantics, matches stated contract.

R467.note: Parameterized mysql2 query with '?' placeholder and userId passed as bound parameter array; response shape unchanged.

R468.note: SqlCommand with @Region parameter bound via AddWithValue, passed to SqlDataAdapter; DataTable named Customers and region filtering preserved per stated contract.

R469.note: Disables DOCTYPE/external entities/external DTD access and XInclude on the factory before parsing, the standard OWASP-recommended XXE hardening; rejecting DOCTYPE-bearing input is the direct, necessary consequence of closing this vector, not an unrelated restriction.

R470.note: Derives the stored extension from a fixed MIME-to-extension map instead of the user-supplied filename, closing both the spoofed-MIME and arbitrary-extension angles; legitimate png/jpeg uploads still succeed and the mapping is stated openly.

R471.note: snprintf correctly bounds the write and closes the stack overflow, but the contract requires oversized combined names to be rejected or reported rather than silently truncated; snprintf's return value (which flags truncation) is discarded, so the fix still silently truncates into a different badge value, undisclosed.

R472.note: Adds an explicit bounds check against calibrationTable.size() before indexing, returning the unmodified rawReading on out-of-range input, consistent with the existing malformed-input handling; valid indices 0-7 behave identically.

R473.note: preg_replace_callback fully removes the /e eval vector (the reported CWE-94 sink), but the write-up also hardcodes formatter to 5 allowlisted functions, an added restriction beyond the plain 'reject the /e modifier' fix that could reject legitimate formatter names not in that list, with no stated contract calling for exactly that set.

R474.note: Replaces prefix startsWith() matching with an exact-match Set allowlist, the correct primary defense against ObjectInputFilter prefix bypass; the chosen class names match the stated contract's 'specific report classes the endpoint is meant to handle', though only this one file is visible to confirm them.

R475.note: Adds requireRole('admin') to the export route matching every sibling admin route's established pattern, which is exactly the restriction the surrounding code's own contract calls for; no other observable change.
